item.name: Azure Storage Accounts Blob Services_ Get Service Properties

query.description: (Required) The API version to use for this operation.

variable.description: (Required) The ID of the target subscription.
(Required) The name of the resource group within the user's subscription. The name is case insensitive.
(Required) The name of the storage account within the specified resource group. Storage account names must be between 3 and 24 characters in length and use numbers and lower-case letters only.
(Required) The name of the blob Service within the specified storage account. Blob Service Name must be 'default'

request.description: Gets the properties of a storage account’s Blob service, including properties for Storage Analytics and CORS (Cross-Origin Resource Sharing) rules.

response.name: OK -- returned the properties of a storage account’s Blob service.

header.description: Added as a part of security scheme: oauth2

query.description: (Required) The API version to use for this operation.
